idea-plugin.name: AI Dev MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Connect IntelliJ IDEA to your self-hosted AI coding agent.

AI Dev MCP runs Qwen2.5-Coder locally via Ollama. Your code never leaves your network.

Features

  • Sidebar panel — submit prompts, watch live SSE streaming output
  • Auto-detects project name from open IntelliJ project — zero config
  • Injects selected code + file path as context automatically
  • Inline editor actions — right-click any code: Fix, Explain, Refactor, Write Tests
  • Workspace Sync — zip & push local project to remote server, run agent, pull changes back
  • Colour-coded diff viewer with Accept / Revert controls
  • All zip/unzip done with pure Kotlin (no external tools needed)
  • Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+M

Requirements

Run the AI Dev MCP server (Node.js 20+, Ollama, ChromaDB) or point to the shared instance at https://ai.decorom.in.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.6.0

  • Fix: POST /run now sends project field instead of path (server API alignment)
  • Fix: SSE event parsing handles CRLF line endings correctly on Windows
  • Version sync between build.gradle.kts and plugin.xml

1.5.0

  • Inline editor actions — right-click any code: Fix with MCP, Explain, Refactor, Write Tests
  • Actions available in Tools → AI Dev MCP menu with keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+F10/F11/F12)
  • Zero-config UX — project always auto-detected, no name field anywhere
  • Real Workspace Sync — zip → upload → run → pull with IntelliJ progress dialog
  • Colour-coded diff rendered in JTextPane (green/red/blue)

1.4.0

  • Removed Project name field from Settings and sidebar — project is always auto-detected from the open project

1.3.0

  • Added Workspace Sync button — zip local folder, push to server, run agent, pull changes back
  • Pure-Kotlin zip/unzip — no PowerShell or external tools required; works on all OS
  • Smart skip of node_modules, .git, build, dist, .gradle when zipping
  • Clear button and Enter key in prompt field
  • Server URL shown in panel header

1.2.0

  • Default server URL pre-set to https://ai.decorom.in
  • API key stored securely via persistent settings; validated before every request
  • Server URL shown in panel so you always know what you are connected to

1.1.0

  • Auto-detects project root path
  • Live SSE step-by-step streaming
